'''Mohammad Mehdi Tehranchi''' ({{langx|fa|محمدمهدی طهرانچی}};{{lrm}} 21 March 1965 – 13 June 2025) was an Iranian [[theoretical physicist]] and [[nuclear scientist]]. He was killed on 13 June 2025 during the [[List of attacks during the Twelve-Day War#Operation Rising Lion|Israeli strikes on the Iranian nuclear program]].<ref name="BBC News">{{Cite news |date=13 June 2025 |title=Who has been killed in Israel's strikes on Iran? |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c93ydeqyq71t?post=asset%3A3ae51c09-ef9e-475b-9c67-80768d5d6a73 |access-date=13 June 2025 |work=BBC News}}</ref><ref name="arab.news">{{Cite web |date=13 June 2025 |title=IRGC commander, 2 nuclear scientists killed in Israeli strikes: Iran state TV |url=https://arab.news/pytuh |access-date=13 June 2025 |website=Arab News}}</ref><ref name="nyt-regalado-25">{{cite news |last1=Regalado |first1=Francesca |title=These are the top Iranian generals and scientists killed by Israel |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/06/13/world/middleeast/iran-military-generals-killed-israel.html |access-date=13 June 2025 |work=The New York Times |date=13 June 2025}}</ref>

== Career ==
A professor at the Laser and Plasma Research Institute and Department of Physics of [[Shahid Beheshti University]], and a member of the board of trustees and president of the [[Islamic Azad University]], he was a rector of the two branches of the [[Islamic Azad University]] (in [[Islamic Azad University, Central Tehran Branch|Central Tehran]] and [[Tehran province|Tehran Province]]) and Shahid Beheshti University.<ref name="محمدمهدی طهرانچی">{{cite web |url=http://facultymembers.sbu.ac.ir/tehranchi/|title=محمدمهدی طهرانچی}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://iau.ac.ir/fa/News/99083/%D8%B3%D8%B1%D9%BE%D8%B1%D8%B3%D8%AA_%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B4%DA%AF%D8%A7%D9%87_%D8%A2%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%AF_%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85%DB%8C_%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%A7%D9%86_%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86_%D9%88_%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AF/|title=دانشگاه آزاد اسلامی|accessdate=13 June 2025}}</ref>

===Awards and honors===
1. Selected as a National Model Professor

2. Awarded the title of the best researcher at Shahid Beheshti University in various periods

3. Received the Allameh Tabatabaei Award for the best academic book

4. Member of the 41st Foundation of the [[Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution]]

5. Received the First Class Scientific Medal from the President<ref name="farajnejad.ir">[https://farajnejad.ir/%DA%A9%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%DB%8C%D9%86-%D8%B2%D9%86%D8%AF%DA%AF%DB%8C%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%87-%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%85%D9%87%D8%AF%DB%8C-%D8%B7%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%DA%86%DB%8C/ کاملترین زندگینامه محمدمهدی طهرانچی | دانشمند هسته‌ای و رئیس دانشگاه آزاد The most complete biography of Mohammad Mehdi Tehranchi | Nuclear scientist and president of Azad University]</ref>

===Publications===

1. Research on the current situation, design of the desired situation, University Press, Tehran, {{ISBN|978-964-01-1366-0}}.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Research on the current situation, design of the desired situation |publisher=University Press |isbn=9789640113660 |location=Tehran}}</ref>

2. Introduction to magnetic materials, University Press Center, Tehran, Author: B.D. Quality, C.D. Graham, Translated by: Mehdi Khodayi, Ramin Dehghan, Mohammad Mehdi Tehranchi, {{ISBN|3-8197-01-964-978}}<ref name="farajnejad.ir"/>

== Post(s) ==
Tehranchi was an Iranian [[theoretical physicist]] and [[nuclear scientist]]. A professor at the Laser and Plasma Research Institute and Department of Physics of [[Shahid Beheshti University]], and a member of the board of trustees and president of the [[Islamic Azad University]], he was a rector of the two branches of the Islamic Azad University (in Central Tehran and [[Tehran province|Tehran Province]]) and Shahid Beheshti University.<ref name="محمدمهدی طهرانچی"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://iau.ac.ir/fa/News/99083|title=دانشگاه آزاد اسلامی|accessdate=13 June 2025}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Tehranchi was born in [[Tehran]] in 1965 into a religious family. He was married and had four children.<ref name="hamshahrionline.ir">[https://www.hamshahrionline.ir/news/954643/%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%85%D9%87%D8%AF%DB%8C-%D8%B7%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%DA%86%DB%8C-%DA%A9%D9%87-%D8%AF%D8%B1-%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%84%D9%87-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B1%DB%8C%D8%B3%D8%AA%DB%8C-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%DB%8C%D9%84-%D8%A8%D9%87-%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AA-%D8%B1%D8%B3%DB%8C%D8%AF-%DA%A9%DB%8C%D8%B3%D8%AA محمدمهدی طهرانچی که در حمله تروریستی اسرائیل به شهادت رسید، کیست؟ + بیوگرافیک Who is Mohammad Mehdi Tehranchi, who was martyred in the Israeli terrorist attack?]</ref><ref>[https://sobhefootballi.ir/fa/news/3545/%D8%A8%DB%8C%D9%88%DA%AF%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%81%DB%8C-%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%85%D9%87%D8%AF%DB%8C-%D8%B7%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%DA%86%DB%8C-%D9%88-%D9%87%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%B4-%D9%88-%D9%81%D8%B1%D8%B2%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B9%DA%A9%D8%B3 بیوگرافی محمدمهدی طهرانچی و همسرش و فرزندان +عکس]</ref>

==Sanctions==
The US State Department, by issuing an official statement titled "Restrictions on Iranian Nuclear Scientists", placed five of the country's nuclear scientists, including Mohammad Mehdi Tehranchi, on its sanctions list.<ref>[https://ana.ir/fa/news/479148/%D8%A2%D9%85%D8%B1%DB%8C%DA%A9%D8%A7-%D8%B1%D8%A6%DB%8C%D8%B3-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B4%DA%AF%D8%A7%D9%87-%D8%A2%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85%DB%8C-%D9%88-4-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B4%D9%85%D9%86%D8%AF-%D9%87%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%E2%80%8C%D8%A7%DB%8C-%D8%AF%DB%8C%DA%AF%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B1%DB%8C%D9%85-%DA%A9%D8%B1%D8%AF US sanctions Islamic Azad University president and 4 other nuclear scientists]</ref>

== Death ==
Tehranchi was killed on 13 June 2025 during the [[Twelve-Day War#13 June|Israeli strikes on the Iranian nuclear program]] at the start of the [[Twelve-Day War]].<ref name="BBC News"/><ref name="arab.news"/><ref name="nyt-regalado-25"/><ref name="hamshahrionline.ir"/> His funeral on 28 June was set to take place alongside those of other scientists and military commanders killed during the Twelve-Day War.<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 June 2025 |title=Iran to hold funerals for top commanders, scientists killed in Israel strikes: State media |url=https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/06/25/iran-to-hold-funerals-for-top-commanders-scientists-killed-in-israel-strikes-state-media |access-date=25 June 2025 |website=Al Arabiya English |language=en}}</ref>
